author: THSV StreamBridge
description: Provides privacy-conscious, salted cross-platform viewer identity and bounded replay-safe progression as an optional foundation for later community add-ons.
changelog: 2.5.1: aligned with the stable THSV StreamBridge 2.5.1 baseline, guided wizard UI, verified update metadata, and regenerated Streamer.bot imports. 2.5.0: aligned with the stable THSV StreamBridge 2.5.0 baseline, guided wizard UI, verified update metadata, and regenerated Streamer.bot imports. 2.4.3: aligned with the stable THSV StreamBridge 2.4.3 baseline, guided wizard UI, verified update metadata, and regenerated Streamer.bot imports. 2.4.2: initial foundation slice with installation-local pseudonyms, explicit stable-ID account links, fixed point awards, chat cooldowns, replay protection, bounded private state, a permission/dependency-gated broker service, and authenticated wizard status, export, correction, and deletion operations.

manifest.name: Viewer Foundation
installationSteps: Install Viewer Foundation in the wizard and review its private-state permission.
Optionally add explicit account links using viewer-id|platform|stable-user-id. Never link accounts by display name.
Choose point awards and cooldowns, save, and restart StreamBridge.
uninstallationSteps: Uninstall the add-on. Its pseudonymous progression state remains preserved for a later reinstall or privacy export.

healthChecks.description: Confirms salted identity resolution, bounded replay protection, and atomic private progression state.
